text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"Bachelor's degree vs Master's degree","dimension":"education level","description":"This captures how advanced the applicant's formal academic training is relative to the role's preferred qualifications.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"7 years of professional software development vs 3 years","dimension":"experience depth","description":"This captures the amount of professional software-development experience the applicant claims in relation to the job's minimum and preferred thresholds.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"writing Go alongside 2 other languages vs 9 other languages","dimension":"language breadth","description":"This captures how broadly the applicant frames their programming-language exposure beyond Go.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"architected agent-based tooling in which Python agents plan and act","dimension":"AI agent emphasis","description":"This captures how directly the letter foregrounds Python agents and agentic tooling for security automation.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"Python is my second working language ... for tooling, automation, and service prototypes","dimension":"Python fluency","description":"This captures the extent to which the applicant explicitly presents Python as a core working language for the role.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"led security reviews of services I did not write","dimension":"security assessment experience","description":"This captures direct experience evaluating systems from a security perspective, which aligns with performing security assessments.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"I join capture-the-flag competitions regularly","dimension":"security practice","description":"This captures extracurricular hands-on security practice beyond formal work experience or certification.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"OSCP certification","dimension":"security certification","description":"This captures formal offensive-security credentialing as evidence of security capability.","winner":"A"}]}
